page_title: MCI 2-0 EVE | Manchester City v Everton 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The match has just finished.
90+11' Unlucky! A great strike from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
90+7' James Garner (Everton) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

90+5' Phil Foden (Manchester City) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Jordan Pickford pulls off an easy save.
90+4' Neat passing move from Manchester City in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90+1' A goal, which was scored by Beto (Everton), was disallowed due to offside.
90' 10 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Here is a change. Idrissa Gueye is going off and Ian Woan gives the last tactical orders to Chermiti (Everton).
88' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Dwight McNeil as he is replaced by Lewis Dobbin (Everton).
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Jack Grealish (Manchester City) coming on for Jeremy Doku.

85' 2 - 0 Goal! Kevin De Bruyne plays a long ball to Erling Haaland (Manchester City), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 2:0.
84' Everton hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
82' Beto (Everton) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

81' Beto (Everton) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
80' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
78' Substitution. Dominic Calvert-Lewin walks off the pitch and Beto (Everton) comes on as a substitute.
78' Ian Woan prepares a substitution. Ashley Young is replaced by Amadou Onana (Everton).
77' Substitution. Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Julian Alvarez walks off.

77' Manchester City players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball is out of play. Everton will take a throw-in.
76' Great teamplay by Manchester City as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
71' 1 - 0 What a hit! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the middle of the net. 1:0.
71' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. Manchester City win a corner.
70' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) steps up to send the ball in.

70' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.
70' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball has crossed the sideline. Manchester City are taking a throw-in.

68' Rodri (Manchester City) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
66' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
66' A cross into the box from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is cleared.
65' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
63' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
63' Dangerous play by Kyle Walker (Manchester City). John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Everton.
63' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
63' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

62' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
61' Manchester City enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
59' Seamus Coleman (Everton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
57' Here comes a substitution. Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is brought on as a substitute for Matheus Nunes.
57' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Manuel Akanji will be replaced by Kyle Walker (Manchester City).
56' Ben Godfrey (Everton) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Seamus Coleman.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Idrissa Gueye (Everton) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' Ben Godfrey (Everton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
50' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
49' A long pass picks out Julian Alvarez (Manchester City), who immediately shoots at goal but sends the ball well wide of the right post.
48' John Brooks blows his whistle as Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
48' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

46' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
46' Referee John Brooks blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+4' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) works the corner short.
45+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City.
45+4' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Manchester City earn a corner.
45+3' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+2' John Stones (Manchester City) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
44' John Brooks blows his whistle after Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Manchester City win a free kick.
43' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is behind the touchline and Manchester City will take a throw-in.
42' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It's a throw-in for Manchester City.

39' The Manchester City players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The ball is out of play. Everton will have a throw-in.
39' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Everton.
38' Jack Harrison (Everton) volleys the ball goalwards, but his effort lacks precision and sails well wide of the left post.
35' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee John Brooks who sees an offensive foul.
33' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
33' Phil Foden (Manchester City) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
32' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
31' A cross from a corner kick by Manchester City is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
31' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
30' Everton showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The linesman signals a throw-in for Manchester City.

28' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
26' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. Everton are awarded the free kick.
26' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
24' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Phil Foden (Manchester City).
23' Phil Foden (Manchester City) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
22' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
21' The ball is cleared after Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Manchester City.
20' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
19' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
17' The Manchester City players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

15' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
14' Manchester City continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
13' John Brooks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Idrissa Gueye (Everton) and blew his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Manchester City.
11' Ederson (Manchester City) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
9' Looks like Ederson (Manchester City) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
7' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Everton will take a throw-in.
6' A player from Everton commits a rough challenge. John Brooks blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick to Manchester City.
5' Manchester City are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
3' A corner kick by Manchester City is thwarted by the well prepared Jordan Pickford (Everton).
3' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Manchester City have a corner.
2' Phil Foden (Manchester City) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester City will have the kick-off.
